latestAccuracySteering.conditionMechanisms: Distinguish effects on statistical accuracy, cost under a fixed budget, and freshness. Key-space sparsity/cell-density variance affect sampling interval convergence; page-level row-size/density heterogeneity, stats sample pages and staleness affect metadata error. A small index, cache, TDE, row width and MVCC mainly change read/CPU/time cost and therefore attainable precision within a fixed budget; they do not make a completed snapshotCOUNT approximate. Concurrent writes/replica lag can change the represented time/population and must not be conflated with estimator error. More sample pages/ANALYZE does not guarantee monotonic accuracy and has separate maintenance impact.
